name: Philipp
headline: Turn E.ON’s usage data into contracts and services that stay.
saw: Across energy, the same tariff and service message usually reaches every household in a segment, whatever its usage, contract end date or payment history, so each customer sees the same thing as everyone else.
The signal you already own, meter readings, consumption peaks, direct debit failures and contract renewal dates, sits in analytics and billing systems, not in the message the customer receives.
Retention and cross-sell campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. The household about to switch supplier this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the switch before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per household from consumption changes, payment failures and contract end dates. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right product to each customer
cases.text: Next best tariff, add-on or service per customer, based on consumption and contract history. Blanket mailings give way to one offer per household that fits.
cases.kpi_label: conversion vs untargeted campaigns, Tier-1 African MNO

cases.head: Keep every customer engaged with the service
cases.text: Personal usage insights, tips and reminders per customer, sent through the channels each customer already uses, so every household has a reason to engage with E.ON each week.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
